POLARIS.Infobulle.jetAttribut: Roll a d20 for this attribute
POLARIS.Infobulle.aptitudeNaturelle: Derived from the attribute's current level; it feeds each skill's base value.
POLARIS.Infobulle.baseCompetence: Sum of the natural aptitudes of both attributes.
POLARIS.Infobulle.globaleCompetence: Base + mastery. This is the value you roll against.
POLARIS.Infobulle.malusBlessures: Wound penalty, applied to every roll.
POLARIS.Infobulle.initiative: Initiative starts at this value on the track.
POLARIS.Aide.jetCompetence: Click a skill to roll it. Hold Shift to roll directly, skipping the configuration dialog.
POLARIS.Aide.rappelLectureDirecte: Direct reading: aim for the highest result without exceeding your target. Landing exactly on it is a critical success.
POLARIS.Aide.blessures: Click a box to fill it, click the last filled one again to clear it. Damage taken sets the severity, the location die sets the column.
POLARIS.Aide.portees: Distance covered by each band. The associated modifier comes from the official sheet.
POLARIS.Avertissement.armeSansPorteur: This weapon belongs to no character: no attack can be rolled.
POLARIS.Avertissement.aptitudeProvisoire: The book's natural aptitude table has not been entered: a provisional formula (current level / 2) applies. All derived values are therefore indicative.
POLARIS.Reglage.ambiance.aide: Sets the Luck score of every character. Luck is not bought with creation points: it follows the tone chosen for the table.
POLARIS.Creation.chanceImposee: Luck is not bought: it is set by the campaign tone.
POLARIS.Creation.aideAmbiance: The tone chosen by the GM sets Luck and the number of base capability points.
POLARIS.Creation.Aide.capacitesBase: Every attribute starts at 7. Raising a level costs 1 point up to 15, 2 from 16 to 18, then 3 for 19 and 20: the last levels come dear.
POLARIS.Creation.Aide.typeGenetique: The genetic type adjusts attributes through the sheet row “Genetic type mod.”.
POLARIS.Creation.Aide.capacitesSpeciales: Generic skills are held by default. Only special ones are bought, and appear on the sheet once acquired.
POLARIS.Creation.Aide.experiencePrelimin: Apprenticeship begins at 12. The years up to the starting age form the character's past: their origins, their training, then their occupations — the latter reserved for characters aged 16 and over.
POLARIS.Creation.Aide.avantages: Two separate pools. Pending the book lists, enter each entry and its cost freely.
POLARIS.Creation.Aide.traitsEnItems: Each filled row will become a “trait” item on the character sheet.
POLARIS.Creation.Avertissement.catalogue: The book catalogue of genetic types is not entered yet: set the type and its modifiers by hand.
POLARIS.Creation.Avertissement.aucuneSpe: No skill is flagged as special in the configuration yet. Set them in module/config.mjs for them to show up here.
POLARIS.Creation.Erreur.budgetDepasse: Budget exceeded: {depense} points spent for {budget} available.
POLARIS.Creation.Avertissement.repartiti: This archetype's automatic distribution is not set in the configuration yet: levels are left as they are, to be distributed by hand.
POLARIS.Creation.Avertissement.coutTypeI: This genetic type's creation point cost is not set yet: it counts as zero, so the displayed total is optimistic.
POLARIS.Infobulle.bonusSecondaire: Bonus or penalty, always added to the calculated value.
POLARIS.Infobulle.totalSecondaire: Effective value, bonus included. This is what counts in play.
POLARIS.Infobulle.tableManquante: The book's conversion table is not entered yet: the raw value is shown as is, so it is provisional.
POLARIS.Creation.manipuleEffetPolaris: This character can manipulate the Polaris effect
POLARIS.Creation.Avertissement.catalogue: The book's mutation catalogue is not entered yet: name each mutation and set its kind and cost by hand.
POLARIS.Creation.Avertissement.coutPolar: The creation point cost of manipulating the Polaris effect is not set: it counts as zero.
POLARIS.Infobulle.modificateurCompetence: Modifier specific to this skill, already included in the base value.
POLARIS.TypeGenetique.humainNormal.descr: The default type, free of charge. Attributes are unmodified and the character has none of the hybrid advantages or disadvantages.
POLARIS.TypeGenetique.hybrideNaturel.des: Also called neo-hybrid, born with every mutation needed to survive underwater. Of all hybrids, the most favoured under water and the most hindered on dry land. Starts with the Hybrid skill at +3. Advantages: aquatic adaptation, cold immunity in water, underwater perception (10 m per Perception point), evolutive mutation. Disadvantages: heat sensitivity (fire damage +3), dependence on water, claustrophobia (-3), Trident block (-2), hunted.
POLARIS.TypeGenetique.genoHybride.descri: A human reshaped by the Trident Cult's technology to survive underwater, without altering their appearance. The Hybrid skill starts at +0. Their evolutive mutation is far less pronounced, heat sensitivity capped at +2, and dependence tested only every two hours. Their Trident block is severe (-7) and their underwater perception shorter (5 m per Perception point).
POLARIS.TypeGenetique.genoHybride.condit: Must have spent at least one year within the Trident Cult's special intervention group.
POLARIS.TypeGenetique.technoHybride.desc: Someone who had to sacrifice their humanity to move freely through the oceans. Physical attributes and underwater skills are greatly increased, but the operations left them horribly disfigured. Called a “creature”, they often have to hide their appearance. They suffer neither the Trident block nor the evolutive mutation, and test dependence only every ten hours, but their underwater perception is the shortest (2 m per Perception point) and they cannot substitute the Hybrid skill for Underwater manoeuvres or Athletics.
POLARIS.TypeGenetique.technoHybride.cond: Must have spent at least 2 years in the Soldier/Militiaman profession.
Must spend at least 1 year in the Techno-hybrid profession after the modification.
POLARIS.Infobulle.tirerMutation: Rolls a mutation on the book's table. A beneficial mutation obtained at random costs no CP — the book only charges for what you choose. A rolled drawback still grants its points.
POLARIS.Creation.Avertissement.tableVide: The mutation catalogue is empty: nothing to roll. Fill in data/capacites-speciales.json.
POLARIS.Creation.Avertissement.tirageInf: The roll matched no mutation. The table probably has a gap: check the catalogue's “tirage” ranges.
POLARIS.Champ.tableMarges: Table of success and failure margins
POLARIS.Aide.tableMarges: Quick reference. A roll's margin — the die itself — converts into a modifier, applied positively or negatively depending on the effect.
POLARIS.Infobulle.tirerAge: 14 + 1D4, so 15 to 18 years. One roll, no retry: more years of apprenticeship, but the risk of being too young to hold an occupation.
POLARIS.Creation.Avertissement.tropJeune: This character is too young to have held an occupation: 16 years are required. Their apprenticeship stopped at basic training.
POLARIS.Creation.Avertissement.catalogue: The book's lists of origins and training are not entered yet: fill them in freely for now.
POLARIS.Creation.Erreur.metierTropJeune: At {age}, this character cannot have held an occupation ({minimum} years required). Remove it, or raise the starting age.
POLARIS.Infobulle.tirerOrigine: Rolls the origin at random. The ranges are not equiprobable: they reflect the world's demographics.
POLARIS.Infobulle.competenceNonDeclaree: This skill is not declared in module/config.mjs yet — its attribute pair is unknown, so the granted level will not be applied.
POLARIS.Creation.Avertissement.sectionSa: This section has no roll die declared in data/origines.json.
